title: New client welcome
description: Welcome new clients with what to expect at the first appointment. Welcome WhatsApp template for salons and spas. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Offer one useful tip (arrival time, patch test). A warm, practical tone helps utility approval.

body.text: Welcome to {{studio}}, {{first_name}}! For your first visit, arrive 10 minutes early and tell us about any allergies. We can't wait to meet you.
